title: Reproducibility package: patient-specific microbial functional potential in longitudinal diabetic foot ulcers
description: Analysis code and nonidentifying derived outputs for a reproducible secondary analysis of longitudinal shotgun-metagenomic functional-potential profiles from BioProject PRJNA506988. The primary estimand is the patient-level median of stage-matched between-patient minus within-patient Bray-Curtis distance across broad SEED Level-1 functional-potential profiles. Version 1.1.0 adds a symmetric exact-visit-pair sensitivity and a two-sided design-preserving randomization sensitivity. This record supports a bounded ecological observation in the source cohort and does not establish functional activity, mechanism, healing relevance, treatment effects, clinical utility, or external validity.
